name: Otsuka
tagline: Shinjuku in 15 minutes and Shibuya in 21 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Toshima City, where JR East and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 21 minutes to Otemachi, 15 minutes to Shinjuku, 21 minutes to Shibuya and 40 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 17.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 13.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 17.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 17.5 m to 30.7 m, a difference of 13.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 19 clinics and 14 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 東弘会山川病院, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 都立大塚病院, about 13 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line run through it. Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line) also call here. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Yamanote Line runs at 136% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 新大久保→新宿, which this station is not on. Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line) is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For quiet, Sugamoshinden; for rail connections, Otsuka.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Otsuka. Sugamoshinden has only the Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line), so Otsuka is the better connected. To Tokyo, for instance, Sugamoshinden takes 8 minutes longer. On quiet, though, Sugamoshinden comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Otsuka is ahead on rail connections and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Otsuka. Mukohara has only the Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line), so Otsuka is the better connected. To Tokyo, for instance, Mukohara takes 9 minutes longer. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 20 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
